milk.read: Class III Milk: funds are net short 6,856 contracts (19.2% of all open contracts), a bigger net short than 98% of weeks since 2010, measured as a share of open interest. At today's open interest, it would take 14,114 contracts of buying to get back to the record-high share of open interest.

crowd.measure: managed-money net as a share of open interest, ranked against every week since 2010
